description: Implemented nonretained QoS1 Will with zero delay, exact attachment installation/cancellation, independent durable pending intention and idempotent normal admission. This subset is descriptive system evidence, not fixture-oracle qualification.
authority: Durable Open commits the immutable Will occurrence before CONNACK; exact End decides cancellation or pending publication; kind17 consumes Pending atomically with admission. Peer removal, timers, absent results and current ClientID lookup grant no publication authority.
limitations: Will QoS0/2, retained Will, nonzero delay, Message Expiry and other Will properties are explicitly unsupported.
A normal DISCONNECT observed only in volatile memory before cancellation commits can be lost with the process; recovery follows the surviving durable intention.
Server failure can defer publication until restart. Capacity pressure retains a bounded Pending intention, without a universal publication-latency claim.

rules.guard: Validated Will QoS1, nonretained, absent or zero delay and bounded immutable topic/payload are part of the exact Open recipe.
Apply the authentic Open result only to its still-live original transport. An Open committed before lost CONNACK is accepted durable state.
Exact attachment End with publish=false atomically removes its Will and applies the captured retention policy.
EOF, RST, Keep Alive, accepted-connection protocol error and explicit DISCONNECT0x04 make this occurrence pending.
Delay0 decides the old attachment for publication before replacement Open installs its own Will or explicit absence.
The independent intention, original producer ClientID and payload survive zero-expiry or replacement cleanup.
Freeze the complete eligible canonical fanout; persist one kind17 WillPublication for this exact Pending intention. A full budget retains intent without truncation.
An unknown admission retains the same OperationId and exact canonical recipe until resolution; absence cannot authorize a new attempt.
The transaction consumes the exact Pending intention, creates normal publication obligations and correlated result, then ordinary delivery drains independently of the source.
After process loss surviving Armed intentions become Pending before source cleanup. Already consumed intentions do not resurrect.
